title: annotate_trade_journal input
description: MCP admin action annotate_trade_journal (mcp:admin:annotate_journal). The trade must exist and be closed (checked server-side). Control characters are stripped server-side. Strict validation: unknown fields are rejected with a generic error (MCP-015). Strings are capped at 128 characters unless the spec sets another cap.

trade_id.description: Closed trade id. Its format is not fixed by the spec.

note.description: Plain text, at most 1,000 characters (MCP §4.1; overrides the MCP-015 128-character default). Stored with content_origin=mcp_client.
